l'eau: We got the daughter of the house over and each had a fine à l’eau.
‘Fine à l’eau,’ bawled a tall dark gentleman immediately in Mr Rolls’s ear.
l'epine: On the utmost peak of the Mont du Nivrolet, which towers east of Chambéry, directly opposite the Chaîne de l’Epine, gleams an immense cross twenty-five meters high, visible from all the surrounding country.
l'ecole: On their last evening they dined recklessly in the Restaurant Chinois of the Rue de l’Ecole de Médécine.
